spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 or p-12 for container padding to let the food imagery breathe.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento Grid Protocol. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 for menu items.
spacing_and_layout.image_constraints: max-h-[60vh] on mobile for hero images. Product card images should have aspect-square.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content. Centered headers only if supporting visual hierarchy.

components.cards: Cardless or 1px subtle border (#E4E4E7). Max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg). Hover effect: -translate-y-1 with subtle shadow-lg.
components.buttons: Primary actions (Cart, Checkout) use cyan or green background with white text. Rounded-full or rounded-lg for a modern look. MUST include hover:bg-opacity-90 or darker shade.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) with 1px bottom border. Must include Logo (ATOM), Links, and Cart icon with badge.
components.cart_drawer: Use Shadcn Sheet component. Right-side drawer. Clear hierarchy: Items -> Total -> Checkout Button.
components.checkout_form: Shadcn Form/Input components. Simple fields: Nombre, Teléfono, Hora de retiro, Notas. Text below button: 'Pago en efectivo al retirar' (Cash on pickup only).
components.admin_panel: Dense grid layout (Control Room Grid). Use Shadcn Table for orders. Status pills: Pendiente (Gray), Preparando (Yellow), Listo (Green), Entregado (Cyan).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Product cards MUST lift slightly on hover. Buttons must have scale-95 on active/click.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion for page or tab transitions (opacity and slight y-axis slide).
motion_and_interactions.cart_interaction: Cart icon must have a subtle bounce animation when an item is added.

media.rules: ONLY use the provided images. NEVER use placeholders. Map exactly to these URLs.

hero_background.description: Minimalist gourmet burger on a white plate. Use as the main hero image on the landing page.

category_fries.description: Crispy crinkle-cut French fries. Use for Fries/Sides category.

category_coffee.description: Cappuccino on a saucer on a wooden table. Use for Coffee category.

product_coffee_1.description: Latte art in a black cup.

category_bakery.description: Slice of cake. Use for Bakery/Pastries category.

about_signage.description: Bakery signage. Use for the footer or 'About Us' section.

instructions_to_main_agent.ui_text: All UI text MUST be in Spanish. E.g., 'Añadir al carrito', 'Finalizar compra', 'Menú', 'Panel de Administración'.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_implementation: Do not implement dark mode. Keep it light, clean, and minimal to showcase the high-quality food photography.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='checkout-submit').
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (ShoppingCart, Menu, Plus, Minus, Trash2).
instructions_to_main_agent.payment_flow: Do NOT integrate Stripe or actual payment gateways. The checkout form must simply collect details and clearly state 'Pago en efectivo al retirar'.
